description: Add the GeoResearch soil-analysis feature: a new feature module lib/features/georesearch/ that produces a structured, AI-generated soil report for the user's location and/or a soil/site photo. The report covers what the user asked for: soil depth/profile, sodium & salinity (salt), nutrients (N/P/K, pH, organic matter), notable substances/contaminants, and soil geometry/texture derived from an optional image. It reuses the existing AI gateway + structured-JSON parsing pattern (like Diagnosis), is location-aware via aiContextProvider/selectedLocationProvider, works fully in demo mode via canned output, and persists reports locally / to Firestore following the diagnosis repository pattern. This feature builds the data/domain/application layers and the result UI; FEAT-004 wires it into navigation, localization, demo gateway, and tests.
steps: Create lib/features/georesearch/domain/soil_report_model.dart modeled on diagnosis_model.dart. Define a `SoilReport` class with a tolerant static `parse(String raw)` (reuse the fenced/balanced-JSON extraction approach from Diagnosis._extractJson — factor a shared helper if clean, otherwise mirror it) plus fromJson/toMap/fromStored/withMeta/toShareText. Fields (all null/empty-tolerant): isSoilRelated (bool), imageQuality (reuse ImageQuality enum from diagnosis or define one), locationSummary (String), soilType/texture (String, e.g. 'sandy loam'), soilDepthCm (a range or descriptor like 'shallow (<30cm)'/'deep'), estimatedSoilDepth (String), salinity (a small typed struct: level low/medium/high + note) , sodiumLevel (level + note), phLevel (String or num + descriptor acidic/neutral/alkaline), organicMatter (String/level), nutrients (List of {name e.g. Nitrogen/Phosphorus/Potassium, level low/medium/high, note}), substances (List of {name, concern low/medium/high, note} for notable substances/contaminants like heavy metals, carbonates, clay minerals), geometry (String describing soil geometry/structure/aggregation visible in an image, e.g. granular, blocky, compacted), suitablePlants (List<String>), recommendations (List<String>), safetyNotes (List<String>), confidence (reuse Confidence enum), needsMoreInformation (bool), followUpQuestions (List<String>), disclaimer (String). Add persistence extras id/imageReference/localImagePath/locationContext/createdAt like Diagnosis. Use enums with `xFrom(String?)` helpers matching the diagnosis pattern (low/medium/high). IMPORTANT: this is an ESTIMATE/EDUCATIONAL feature — the model and prompt must be explicit that real soil metrics require a lab test; never present fabricated precise numbers as measured fact.

Extend lib/core/services/ai_prompts.dart with a `soilResearchInstruction()` (and if useful a dedicated system augmentation) that instructs the model to return ONLY a valid JSON object matching the SoilReport schema above (mirror the diagnosisInstruction() style: list the exact JSON keys and allowed enum string values). The instruction must: use only provided context (location/coordinates/weather) and the optional image; clearly label estimates as approximate and recommend a professional soil lab test for exact sodium/salinity/nutrient values; refuse to invent precise measured numbers; set isSoilRelated=false for unrelated images; keep confidence conservative; and include the standard disclaimer. It should incorporate any location/region context to reason about likely regional soil characteristics without asserting site-specific certainty.

Create lib/features/georesearch/data/soil_research_service.dart modeled on ai_diagnosis_service.dart: a `SoilResearchService(this._gateway)` with an `analyze({required String locale, AiImage? image, Map<String,String> context = const {}, String? userNote, double? latitude, double? longitude})` that builds an AiRequest (systemPrompt: AiPrompts.system(locale) possibly plus soil augmentation, userText: combines optional userNote + AiPrompts.soilResearchInstruction(), context: the passed context map optionally enriched with latitude/longitude strings, image: image, jsonMode:true) and calls _gateway.generate(...), then SoilReport.parse(raw), mapping FormatException to AppException(malformedResponse). Expose `final soilResearchServiceProvider = Provider(...)` wiring ref.watch(aiGatewayProvider), matching aiDiagnosisServiceProvider.

Create lib/features/georesearch/data/soil_report_repository.dart modeled on diagnosis_repository.dart: abstract SoilReportRepository { load(); save(report, {imageBytes, retainImage}); delete(id); deleteAll(); } with a LocalSoilReportRepository(LocalCacheService) storing JSON under a key like 'soil_reports_local' (never storing raw image bytes) and a FirestoreSoilReportRepository storing under users/{uid}/soilReports/{id} with optional Storage image upload gated on retainImage (mirror the diagnosis repo exactly, including chunk-safe deleteAll per FEAT-002's fix if applicable). Use uuid for ids.

Create lib/features/georesearch/application/soil_research_provider.dart modeled on diagnosis_provider.dart: a `soilReportRepositoryProvider` selecting Firestore vs Local by Environment.isDemo + currentUser; a stage enum (e.g. input, analyzing, result), an immutable SoilResearchState with copyWith (fields: stage, optional imageBytes, SoilReport? result, AppException? error, bool saved), a SoilResearchController extends StateNotifier<SoilResearchState> with methods: setImage(bytes) (optional image path), analyze({String? note}) that reads aiContextProvider + selectedLocationProvider (for latitude/longitude/city) + localeProvider, compresses the image if present (reuse ImageCompressor), calls soilResearchServiceProvider.analyze(...), guards against duplicate/superseded requests with a _seq counter + a min-interval like DiagnosisController, saveCurrent() using the repository + imageRetentionProvider, and reset(). Add `soilResearchControllerProvider` and a `soilReportHistoryProvider = FutureProvider<List<SoilReport>>`.

Create the presentation layer under lib/features/georesearch/presentation/: georesearch_screen.dart (a stateful/consumer screen driving the stage enum: an input step letting the user optionally attach a soil/site photo via image_picker like diagnosis, showing the current location context strip from aiContextProvider.displayStrip, and a 'Analyze soil' button; an analyzing step with a loading view; a result step rendering the report) and presentation/widgets/soil_report_card.dart rendering SoilReport with clearly-sectioned cards for: location/soil type & depth, salinity & sodium, pH & organic matter, nutrients (N/P/K list with low/medium/high chips), substances/contaminants, soil geometry/structure, suitable plants, recommendations, safety notes, confidence badge, and the disclaimer. Reuse existing shared widgets (app_loading_view, app_error_view, app_empty_view, simple_markdown, and the styling used in diagnosis_result_card.dart). All user-facing text must use AppLocalizations keys (added in FEAT-004); use placeholder l10n keys now and ensure FEAT-004 adds them. Include a 'Save' action and, where sensible, an 'Ask a follow-up in chat' affordance mirroring diagnosis. Prominently show the estimate/lab-test disclaimer.
Do NOT modify functions/ (the Cloud Function proxy is generic and passes system/text/context/image through unchanged — georesearch works over the existing backend, direct, and demo transports).

After creating files, run `flutter analyze` and fix any issues so the module compiles clean. Some l10n getters referenced here will not exist until FEAT-004 adds the .arb keys and regenerates; if that blocks analyze, coordinate by adding the required .arb keys as part of this feature OR leave a clearly-marked TODO list of the exact l10n keys needed and use literal English fallbacks temporarily — but the end state after FEAT-004 must be fully localized and analyze-clean.
acceptance_criteria: New module exists: lib/features/georesearch/{domain/soil_report_model.dart, data/soil_research_service.dart, data/soil_report_repository.dart, application/soil_research_provider.dart, presentation/georesearch_screen.dart, presentation/widgets/soil_report_card.dart}
SoilReport.parse tolerates ```json fences and surrounding prose and extracts a balanced JSON object, matching the Diagnosis.parse behavior (covered by a test in FEAT-004)
SoilResearchService builds an AiRequest with jsonMode:true and location/context, calls aiGatewayProvider, and returns a parsed SoilReport (or AppException(malformedResponse) on bad output)

The feature captures soil depth, sodium/salinity, nutrients (N/P/K), pH, organic matter, notable substances, and soil geometry/texture, and clearly labels values as estimates that require a professional lab test
`flutter analyze` reports 'No issues found!' for the new module (allowing that l10n keys are finalized in FEAT-004)
verification: export PATH="/opt/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH" && flutter pub get && flutter analyze
findings: Implemented the GeoResearch soil-analysis module mirroring the diagnosis feature. Files created: lib/features/georesearch/domain/soil_report_model.dart (SoilReport + SoilMeasure/SoilNutrient/SoilSubstance + SoilLevel enum with soilLevelFrom; reuses Confidence/ImageQuality from diagnosis via show/export; tolerant static parse() copied from Diagnosis._extractJson; fromJson/toMap/fromStored/withMeta/toShareText; stored under 'report' key), data/soil_research_service.dart (SoilResearchService.analyze builds AiRequest jsonMode:true, enriches context with lat/lon, maps FormatException -> AppException(malformedResponse); soilResearchServiceProvider), data/soil_report_repository.dart (abstract + LocalSoilReportRepository key 'soil_reports_local' + FirestoreSoilReportRepository users/{uid}/soilReports/{id}, deleteAll uses FirestoreBatch.deleteAll chunk-safe helper, Storage upload gated on retainImage), application/soil_research_provider.dart (soilReportRepositoryProvider selects Firestore vs Local by Environment.isDemo+currentUser; SoilResearchStage enum input/analyzing/result; immutable SoilResearchState+copyWith; SoilResearchController with setImage/clearImage/analyze/cancelAnalysis/saveCurrent/reset, _seq de-dup + minTimeBetweenDiagnoses guard, reads aiContextProvider/selectedLocationProvider/localeProvider, compresses optional image via ImageCompressor; soilResearchControllerProvider + soilReportHistoryProvider), presentation/georesearch_screen.dart (stage-driven GeoResearchScreen: input step with optional image_picker photo via bottom sheet + location strip from aiContextProvider.displayStrip + Analyze button, analyzing loading step, result step with Save/Ask-follow-up-in-chat/Share/Reset), presentation/widgets/soil_report_card.dart (sectioned card: confidence badge, prominent estimate/lab-test banner, location/soil type/depth, salinity & sodium, pH & organic matter, nutrients N/P/K with level chips, substances with concern chips, geometry, suitable plants chips, recommendations, safety notes, disclaimer). Extended lib/core/services/ai_prompts.dart with soilResearchInstruction() (full JSON schema + enum strings, estimates-only + lab-test requirement, isSoilRelated=false for unrelated images, conservative confidence, disclaimer) plus a stable marker AiPrompts.soilResearchMarker='PLANTSENSE_SOIL_RESEARCH_V1' embedded in the instruction so FEAT-004's demo gateway can detect soil-research requests. Localization: added all georesearch keys to lib/l10n/app_en.arb (template) with full Arabic translations in app_ar.arb; added navGeoResearch + georesearchTitle translations to app_fr.arb/app_es.arb (other keys fall back to English per existing sparse-translation convention, matching how diagnosis keys are handled). Regenerated lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart via flutter pub get (never hand-edited). NOTE: no navigation wiring was added (home_screen tab/HomeTab index) — that is FEAT-004's responsibility per the plan; GeoResearchScreen is a self-contained tab body ready to slot in. Verification: `flutter pub get && flutter analyze` -> 'No issues found!'; `flutter test` -> all 61 tests pass (no regressions). No new l10n keys are left as TODO — all keys used by this module exist in the .arb + generated files. functions/ untouched.
